column1: Start the night before: brine the turkey with the Turkey Brine recipe, then pull it out, pat it dry, and leave it uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry out.
Gently peel the skin back from the breast and legs and spread softened butter underneath.
Season the outside of the turkey with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Roast 33 minutes per kg (15 minutes per lb) at 330°F (165°C). A 6.75 kg (15 lb) turkey takes about 3 3/4 hours. Once the skin turns golden brown, tent the turkey loosely with foil to prevent burning.
Rest at least 30 minutes before carving.
